# Shameless Pets

> Shameless Pets offers upcycled, grain-free dog and cat treats in multiple formats including dental sticks, soft-baked biscuits, jerky, crunchy bites, and meaty tenders.

Shameless Pets specializes in sustainable pet nutrition by using upcycled ingredients to reduce food waste while providing high-quality treats for dogs and cats. The brand focuses on functional benefits like dental care, digestion support, and immune health across their diverse product lineup.

## Product Collections

- [All Collections](https://shamelesspets.com/collections): Main collections hub for dog and cat treats organized by treat type
- [All Products](https://shamelesspets.com/collections/all): Main product collection showcasing all Shameless Pets treat types and flavors
- [Dental Treats](https://shamelesspets.com/collections/dental-treats): Dental treats collection featuring dental sticks and minis for oral care
- [Soft and Chewy Treats](https://shamelesspets.com/collections/soft-and-chewy-treats): Soft and chewy meaty tenders product collection with beef, bacon, chicken
- [Soft Baked Treats](https://shamelesspets.com/collections/soft-treats): Soft baked treats collection with fruit and protein flavors
- [Jerky Treats](https://shamelesspets.com/collections/meaty-treats): Jerky bites collection featuring duck and salmon meat-based treats
- [Crunchy Dog Treats](https://shamelesspets.com/collections/crunchy-dog-treats-1): Crunchy bites collection with bacon, peanut butter, and snack mix flavors
- [Crunchy Cat Treats](https://shamelesspets.com/collections/crunchy-cat-treats-1): Crunchy cat treats with catnip and various protein flavors
- [Training Treats](https://shamelesspets.com/collections/training-treats): Training treats collection with bone broth bits for dog training
